description: This file defines the root Angular component for the shopping front-end application, handling UI interactions such as search, filter by category, price range filters, and displaying cart and category data.

classes.name: AppComponent
classes.description: The main Angular component for the shopping application, managing user interactions and data bindings.

methods.name: onSearch
methods.description: Navigates to the root route with a search query parameter based on the user's input.

methods.name: filterBy
methods.description: Applies a category filter by updating the router query parameters.

methods.name: applyFilters
methods.description: Applies min and max price filters through route query parameters.

methods.name: clearFilters
methods.description: Clears all search and filter parameters, resetting the view.
